title: Vanishing of $\mathrm{Sha}(A/K)[\mathfrak{P}^\infty]$ and its consequences for the anticyclotomic Iwasawa theory of $\mathrm{GL}_2$-abelian varieties
summary: In this article we generalise a classical Kolyvagin's result on the vanishing of the $p$-part of the Shafarevich--Tate group of an elliptic curve (defined over $\mathbb{Q}$) over an imaginary quadratic field $K$ to modular abelian varieties of $\mathrm{GL}_2$-type (defined over a totally real number field $F$) and a CM field $K/F$. Combining this result with the abstract Iwasawa-theoretical argument of [MN19], we show that a similar vanishing holds over the layers of a suitably defined anticyclotomic multi-$\mathbb{Z}_p$-extension of $K$.
